title: Piano performances
hook: The MAESTRO dataset gathers recordings from nine years of the International Piano-e-Competition, where “virtuoso pianists perform on Yamaha Disklaviers which, in addition to being concert-quality acoustic grand pianos, utilize an integrated high-precision MIDI capture and playback system.” The MIDI data “includes key strike velocities and sustain pedal positions”; additional metadata contains each performance’s year, composer, and title.
